purpose: Freeze a public SEC MIDAS market-structure friction state and test historical public-availability/PIT feasibility before any performance evaluation.

external_basis.source: U.S. SEC Market Structure Data Downloads / MIDAS
external_basis.observation: SEC publishes individual-security market-structure datasets with daily security records and fields including Cancels, Trades, OddLots, Hidden, OrderVol and TradeVol; current public downloads extend through June 2026.

The methodology defines cancel-to-trade, trade-to-order, hidden and odd-lot measures and states that the CRSP security universe is updated monthly with a 3-4 week lag from the prior month's final trading day.

candidates.name: SEC MIDAS Market-Friction State
candidates.hypothesis: A frozen market-structure state derived from publicly published order cancellation, trade-to-order, hidden-activity and odd-lot activity may represent a friction/participation regime not reducible to daily OHLCV momentum or volatility.

construction.cadence: daily source observations, consumed only at a verified public-availability cutoff
construction.state_rule: predeclared deterministic normalization only; no fitted weights, thresholds, asset selection or horizon selection
construction.release_clock: each source release is treated as a versioned availability event; a historical decision may use only versions whose public availability is independently evidenced before the decision timestamp

pit_requirements: historical release/publication timestamps or an independently auditable public-availability reconstruction
security-universe membership cutoff and its monthly lag treatment
ticker/security identity continuity and delisting handling
explicit handling of the November 3, 2025 round-lot definition change
no post-release revision/correction may enter an earlier decision point
cheap_falsification_tests: attempt release-clock reconstruction from SEC page history/RSS/archive evidence for multiple quarterly vintages
verify that a decision date cannot see later quarter files
verify that the source universe for each decision is the universe actually available at that cutoff
verify field semantics across the 2025-11-03 round-lot regime transition
prove deterministic mapping from raw published fields to frozen state without fitted parameters
discard_conditions: historical public-availability timestamp cannot be reconstructed with sufficient auditability
security-universe cutoff cannot be pinned to the decision date
field definitions are not stable/version-controlled across the study window
the 2025-11-03 round-lot regime change cannot be modeled explicitly
any state construction requires information unavailable at the decision timestamp
candidates.next_gate: Q125-F1 SEC publication-clock and vintage audit

notes: Q125 remains discovery/feasibility design only and contains no project performance evidence.

The current SEC pages expose quarterly downloadable vintages through June 2026, while the methodology separately describes a lagged monthly security universe; the project therefore treats release availability and universe membership as separate PIT dimensions.
The SEC page exposes an RSS feed for market-structure data updates, but the feed's historical timestamp semantics must still be established before it can serve as a PIT clock.
The November 3, 2025 round-lot rule change is a mandatory regime-version field and cannot be silently pooled with pre-change observations.
No ranking, selection, tuning, holdout use, performance authorization, promotion or live execution is permitted.
